name: Lay on Hands
description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to 100% your maximum health.\n\nCannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Avenging Wrath
description: Call upon the Light to become an avatar of retribution, increasing your damage, healing, and critical strike chance by 20% for 20 sec.

name: Blessing of Sacrifice
description: Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.\n\nLast 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.

name: Blinding Light
description: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yds, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Divine Toll
description: Instantly cast Holy Shock, Avenger's Shield, or Judgment on up to 5 targets within 30 yds.

name: Execution Sentence
description: Unleash a heavenly blast around the target, dealing 176 Holy damage to all enemies within 10 yds, and call down a hammer that slowly falls from the sky upon the target. \n\nAfter 10 sec, they suffer 20% of the Holy damage you dealt to all targets affected by the initial blast during that time.

name: Rebuke
description: Interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

name: Turn Evil
description: The power of the Light compels an Undead, Aberration, or Demon target to flee for up to 40 sec. Damage may break the effect. Lesser creatures have a chance to be destroyed. Only one target can be turned at a time.

name: Cleanse Toxins
description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing all Poison and Disease effects.

name: Blessing of Protection
description: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to Physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.\n\nCannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Divine Steed
description: Leap atop your Charger for 3 sec, increasing movement speed by 100%. Usable while indoors or in combat.

name: Blade of Justice
description: Pierce an enemy with a blade of light, dealing 67 Holy damage.\n\nGenerates 1 Holy Power.

name: Divine Storm
description: Unleashes a whirl of divine energy, dealing 93 Holy damage to all nearby enemies. \n\nDeals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Eternal Flame
description: Heals an ally for 1,436 and an additional 465 over 16 sec.\n\nHealing increased by 25% when cast on self.

name: Final Verdict
description: Unleashes a powerful weapon strike that deals 161 Holy damage to an enemy target,\n\nHas a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Judgment.

name: Shield of Vengeance
description:
Divine Protection reduces damage taken by an additional 10% and casts Shield of Vengeance.

Shield of Vengeance
Creates a barrier of holy light that absorbs 9,165 damage for 10 sec.

When the shield expires, it bursts to inflict Holy damage equal to the total amount absorbed, divided among all nearby enemies.

name: Wake of Ashes
description:
Lash out at your enemies, dealing 114 Radiant damage to all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, and applying Truth's Wake, burning the targets for an additional 67 damage over 9 sec.

Demon and Undead enemies are also stunned for 5 sec.

Generates 3 Holy Power.

name: Blessing of Freedom
description: Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.

name: Intercession
description: Petition the Light on the behalf of a fallen ally, restoring spirit to body and allowing them to reenter battle with 60% health and at least 20% mana.

name: Divine Shield
description: Grants immunity to all damage, harmful effects, knockbacks and forced movement effects for 8 sec. \n\nCannot be used if you have Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

name: Jailer's Judgment
description: Stuns the target Player for 6 sec. If the judgment holds for 6 sec, the enemy will be instantly teleported to your jail. Can only be used while in Ashran.

name: Tyr's Deliverance
description: Releases the Light within yourself, healing 5 injured allies instantly and an injured ally every 0.9 sec within 40 yds for 133.\n\nAllies healed also receive 10% increased healing from your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells for 12 sec.

name: Divine Protection
description: Reduces all damage you take by 20% for 8 sec. Usable while stunned.

name: Eye of Tyr
description: Releases a blinding flash from Truthguard, causing 19 Holy damage to all nearby enemies within 8 yds and reducing all damage they deal to you by 25% for 9 sec.

name: Hammer of Justice
description: Stuns the target for 6 sec.

name: Holy Prism
description:
Fires a beam of light that scatters to strike a clump of targets. 

If the beam is aimed at an enemy target, it deals 2,470 Holy damage and radiates 2,610 healing to 5 allies within 30 yds.

If the beam is aimed at a friendly target, it heals for 5,886 and radiates 929 Holy damage to 5 enemies within 30 yds.

Generates 3 Holy Power.

name: Contemplation
description: Allows you a moment of peace as you kneel in quiet contemplation to ponder the nature of the Light.

name: Shield of the Righteous
description: Slams enemies in front of you with your shield, causing 33 Holy damage, and increasing your Armor by 608 for 4.5 sec.

name: Ancient Fury
description: Unleash the fury of ancient kings, causing 10 Holy damage per application of Ancient Power, divided evenly among all targets within 10 yards.

name: Ardent Defender
description: Reduces all damage you take by 30% for 12 sec.\n\nWhile Ardent Defender is active, the next attack that would otherwise kill you will instead bring you to 20% of your maximum health.

name: Beacon of Light
description: Wrap a single ally in holy energy, causing your direct healing on other party or raid members to also heal that ally for 10% of the amount healed.

name: Consecration
description: Deals 1 Holy damage every 0.9 sec to enemies within 8 yards.

name: Crusader Aura
description: Increases mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yds.

name: Crusader Strike
description: Strike the target for 49 Physical damage.\n\nGenerates 1 Holy Power.

name: Crusader's Direhorn
description: Summons a Crusader's Direhorn, which serves as a mount.

name: Devotion Aura
description: Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

name: Earthen Ordinant's Ramolith
description: Summons the Earthen Ordinant's Ramolith, which serves as a mount.

name: Flash of Light
description: Quickly heal a friendly target for 1,187.

name: Hammer of Wrath
description: Hurls a divine hammer that strikes an enemy for 76 Holy damage.\n\nGenerates 1 Holy Power.

name: Hand of Reckoning
description: Commands the attention of an enemy target, forcing them to attack you and increasing the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Holy Shock
description: Triggers a burst of Light on the target, dealing 817 Holy damage to an enemy, or 4,229 healing to an ally.\n\nGenerates 1 Holy Power.

name: Judgment
description: Judges the target, dealing 380 Holy damage.

name: Light of the Ancient Kings
description: Heals the target of your heals for 30% of the amount healed.

name: Light's Hammer
description: Hurls a Light-infused hammer to the ground, dealing 77 Holy damage to nearby enemies and healing up to 6 nearby allies for 179, every 2 sec for 14 sec.

name: Protector of the Innocent
description: Casting a targeted heal on any target, except yourself, also heals you for 20.

name: Redemption
description: Brings a dead ally back to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Retribution Aura
description: When any party or raid member within 40 yds takes more than 30% of their health in damage in a single hit, each member gains 5% increased damage and healing, decaying over 30 sec. This cannot occur within 30 sec of the aura being applied.

name: Sense Undead
description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Summon Charger
description: Summons a Charger, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Darkforge Ram
description: Summons a Darkforge Ram, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Dawnforge Ram
description: Summons a Dawnforge Ram, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Exarch's Elekk
description: Summons an Exarch's Elekk, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Great Exarch's Elekk
description: Summons an Great Exarch's Elekk, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Great Sunwalker Kodo
description: Summons a Great Sunwalker Kodo, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Lightforged Ruinstrider
description: Summons a Lightforged Ruinstrider, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Sunwalker Kodo
description: Summons a Sunwalker Kodo, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Thalassian Charger
description: Summons a Thalassian Charger, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Thalassian Warhorse
description: Summons a Thalassian Warhorse, which serves as a mount.

name: Summon Warhorse
description: Summons a Warhorse, which serves as a mount.

name: Templar's Verdict
description: Unleashes a powerful weapon strike that deals 61 Holy damage to an enemy target.

name: Word of Glory
description: Calls down the Light to heal a friendly target for 1,606.

name: Blessing of Sanctuary
description: Instantly removes all stun, silence, fear and horror effects from the friendly target and reduces the duration of future such effects by 60% for 5 sec.

name: Searing Glare
description: Call upon the light to blind enemy players in a 25 yd cone, causing enemies to miss their spells and attacks for 4 sec.

name: Blessing of Spellwarding
description:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.

Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.

Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection.

name: Hallowed Ground
description: Your Consecration clears and suppresses all snare effects on allies within its area of effect.

name: Luminescence
description: Lightbearer's healing transfer is increased by up to 150% based on your current health. Lower health heals allies for more.

name: Shining Revelation
description: The light reveals all enemies in stealth or invisible to you while under the effects of Divine Shield. This effect lingers for 20 sec after Divine Shield fades.

name: Spellbreaker
description: Eye for an Eye can now also trigger at 100% effectiveness from direct Magic damage.

name: Spreading the Word
description:
Your allies affected by your Aura gain an effect after you cast Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Freedom.

 Blessing of Protection
Physical damage reduced by 30% for 6 sec.

 Blessing of Freedom
Cleared of all movement impairing effects.

name: Ultimate Retribution
description: Mark an enemy player for retribution after they kill an ally within your active Aura. If the marked enemy is slain within 12 sec, cast Redemption on the fallen ally.

name: A Just Reward
description: After Cleanse successfully removes an effect from an ally, they are healed for 2,052.

name: Afterimage
description: After you spend 20 Holy Power, your next Word of Glory echoes onto a nearby ally at 30% effectiveness.

name: Art of War
description: Your auto attacks have a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of Blade of Justice.\n\nCritical strikes increase the chance by an additional 10%.

name: Auras of the Resolute
description:
Learn Concentration Aura, Devotion Aura, and Crusader Aura:

Concentration Aura:
Interrupt and Silence effects on party and raid members within 40 yds are 30% shorter. 

 Devotion Aura:
Party and raid members within 40 yds are bolstered by their devotion, reducing damage taken by 3%.

 Crusader Aura:
Increases mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yds.

name: Aurora
description:
After you cast Holy Prism or Divine Toll, gain Divine Purpose.

 Divine Purpose
Your next Holy Power spending ability is free and deals 15% increased damage and healing.

name: Blade of Vengeance
description: Blade of Justice now hits nearby enemies for 20 Holy damage. \n\nDeals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

name: Blades of Light
description: Crusader Strike, Judgment and Blade of Justice deal 10% increased damage.

name: Blessed Calling
description: Allies affected by your Blessings have 15% increased movement speed.

name: Blessed Champion
description: Crusader Strike and Judgment hit an additional 4 targets but deal 25% reduced damage to secondary targets.

name: Blessing of An'she
description: The healing and damage of Holy Shock is increased by 15%.

name: Blessing of Dawn
description: While you are above 85% health, 5% of all damage taken by allies within 20 yds is redirected to you, up to a maximum of 1,527 every 5 sec.

name: Blessing of Dusk
description: Damage taken reduced by up to 10%, increasing as your health decreases.

name: Bonds of Fellowship
description: You receive 20% less damage from Blessing of Sacrifice and each time its target takes damage, you gain 4% movement speed up to a maximum of 40%.

name: Born in Sunlight
description: Dawnlight's critical strike chance is increased by 15% during Avenging Wrath.

name: Boundless Judgment
description: Judgment has a 50% increased chance to trigger Mastery: Highlord's Judgment.

name: Brought to Light
description: Killing an enemy that yields experience or honor causes you to explode with holy energy, healing up to 5 nearby allies and yourself for 218, split evenly among them.

name: Burn to Ash
description: When Truth's Wake critically strikes, its duration is extended by 2 sec.\n\nYour other damage over time effects deal 30% increased damage to targets affected by Truth's Wake.

name: Burning Crusade
description: Your damage over time effects deal 10% more damage.

name: Cavalier
description: Divine Steed now has 2 charges.

name: Consecrated Ground
description: Your Consecration is 15% larger, and enemies within it have 50% reduced movement speed.

name: Crusade
description: Avenging Wrath now grants you 2% Haste.\n\nEach Holy Power spent during Avenging Wrath increases Haste by an additional 2%, up to 20%.

name: Crusading Strikes
description: Crusader Strike replaces your auto-attacks and deals 80 Physical damage.\n\nAuto-attack speed is decreased by 15%.

name: Dawnlight
description:
Casting Holy Prism or Divine Toll causes your next 2 Holy Power spending abilities to apply Dawnlight on your target, dealing 1,327 Radiant damage or 2,802 healing over 8 sec.

8% of Dawnlight's damage and healing radiates to nearby allies or enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Dawnlight's healing does not transfer to Beacon of Light.

name: Divine Exaction
description: Divine Toll casts 2 additional times on your target at 100% effectiveness.

name: Divine Hammer
description:
Divine Toll summons Divine Hammers that spin around you for 8 sec.

Divine Hammer
Strikes all enemies nearby for 50 Holy damage every 2 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Divine Purpose
description: Holy Power spending abilities have a 10% chance to make your next Holy Power spending ability free and deal 10% increased damage and healing.

name: Divine Reach
description: The radius of your auras is increased by 20 yds.

name: Divine Resonance
description: After casting Divine Toll, you instantly cast Holy Shock every 5 sec for 15 sec.

name: Divine Spurs
description: Divine Steed's cooldown is reduced by 20%, but its duration is reduced by 40%.

name: Divine Wrath
description: Increases the duration of Avenging Wrath or Crusade by 4 sec.

name: Empyreal Ward
description: Lay on Hands grants the target 30% increased armor for 8 sec and now ignores healing reduction effects.

name: Empyrean Legacy
description: Avenging Wrath empowers your next Word of Glory to automatically activate Light of Dawn with 25% increased effectiveness.

name: Empyrean Power
description: Crusader Strike has a 15% chance to make your next Divine Storm free and deal 15% additional damage.

name: Endless Gleam
description: Dawnlight's duration is increased by 0.5 sec when it heals an ally with full health.

name: Endless Wrath
description: Empyrean Hammer has a 10% increased chance to critically strike.

name: Expurgation
description: Your Blade of Justice causes the target to burn for 27 Radiant damage over 9 sec. When reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new effect.

name: Eye for an Eye
description: Melee and ranged attackers receive 133 Holy damage each time they strike you during Divine Protection and Divine Shield.

name: Faith's Armor
description: Word of Glory grants 20% bonus armor for 4.5 sec.

name: Fear No Evil
description: Fear duration on you reduced by 20%. This effect is increased to 60% during Avenging Wrath.

name: Fist of Justice
description: Hammer of Justice's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Gleaming Rays
description: Your Holy Power spenders deal 3% additional damage and healing.

name: Golden Path
description: Consecration heals you and 5 allies within it for 2 every 0.9 sec.

name: Greater Judgment
description: Judgment causes the target to take 20% increased damage from your next Holy Power ability.\n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Guided Prayer
description: When your health is brought below 25%, you instantly cast a free Word of Glory at 60% effectiveness on yourself.\n\nCannot occur more than once every 60 sec.

name: Hammerfall
description: Templar's Verdict calls down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby enemy.\n\nWhile Shake the Heavens is active, this effect calls down an additional Empyrean Hammer.

name: Healing Hands
description: The cooldown of Lay on Hands is reduced up to 60%, based on the target's missing health.\n\nWord of Glory's healing is increased by up to 100% on yourself, based on your missing health.

name: Heart of the Crusader
description: Crusader Strike and auto-attacks deal 10% increased damage and deal 10% increased critical strike damage.

name: Higher Calling
description: Crusader Strike, Hammer of Wrath and Blade of Justice extend the duration of Shake the Heavens by 1 sec.

name: Highlord's Wrath
description: Mastery: Highlord's Judgment is 50% more effective on Judgment and Hammer of Wrath. Judgment applies an additional stack of Greater Judgment if it is known.

name: Holy Aegis
description: Armor and critical strike chance increased by 4%.

name: Holy Blade
description: Blade of Justice generates 1 additional Holy Power.

name: Holy Flames
description: You deal 5% increased Holy damage to targets burning from your Expurgation.

name: Holy Reprieve
description: Your Forbearance's duration is reduced by 10 sec.

name: Holy Ritual
description: Allies are healed for 7,426 when you cast Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Sacrifice on them.

name: Illumine
description: Dawnlight reduces the movement speed of enemies by 50% and increases the movement speed of allies by 20%.

name: Improved Blade of Justice
description: Blade of Justice now has 2 charges.

name: Improved Blessing of Protection
description: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Protection by 60 sec.

name: Improved Judgment
description: Judgment now has 2 charges.

name: Inspired Guard
description: Divine Protection increases healing taken by 15% for its duration.

name: Judge, Jury and Executioner
description: Holy Power spending abilities deal 5% increased damage.\n\nAfter casting Execution Sentence, your next 1 Holy Power ability will refund its Holy Power cost.

name: Judgment of Justice
description: Judgment deals 10% increased damage and increases your movement speed by 10% for 5 sec.\n\nIf you have Greater Judgment, Judgment slows enemies by 30% for 8 sec.

name: Jurisdiction
description: Templar's Verdict and Blade of Justice deal 10% increased damage.\n\nThe range of Blade of Justice is increased to 20 yds.

name: Lead the Charge
description: Divine Steed reduces the cooldown of 4 nearby ally's major movement ability by 3.0 sec.\n\nYour movement speed is increased by 3%.

name: Light Within
description: Art of War increases the damage of your next Blade of Justice by 80% and can now accumulate an additional time.

name: Light of Justice
description: Reduces the cooldown of Blade of Justice by 2 sec.

name: Light's Countenance
description: The cooldown of Blinding Light is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Light's Deliverance
description: You gain a stack of Light's Deliverance when you call down an Empyrean Hammer.\n\nWhile Wake of Ashes and Hammer of Light are unavailable, you consume 60 stacks of Light's Deliverance, empowering yourself to cast Hammer of Light an additional time for free.

name: Light's Guidance
description:
Wake of Ashes is replaced with Hammer of Light for 20 sec after it is cast.

 Hammer of Light:
Hammer down your enemy with the power of the Light, dealing 245 Holy damage and 121 Holy damage up to 7 nearby enemies. 

Additionally, calls down Empyrean Hammers from the sky to strike 3 nearby enemies for 16 Holy damage each.

Costs 5 Holy Power.

name: Light's Judicator
description: Empyrean Hammer deals 20% increased critical strike damage and its critical strikes have 50% chance to grant an additional stack of Light's Deliverance.

name: Light's Revocation
description: Removing harmful effects with Divine Shield heals you for 10% for each effect removed.  This heal cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.\n\nDivine Shield may now be cast while Forbearance is active.

name: Lightbearer
description: 10% of all healing done to you from other sources heals up to 4 nearby allies, divided evenly among them.

name: Lightforged Blessing
description: Divine Storm heals you and up to 2 nearby allies for 43.

name: Lingering Radiance
description: Dawnlight leaves an Eternal Flame for 6 sec on allies or a Greater Judgment on enemies when it expires or is extended.

name: Luminosity
description: Critical Strike chance of Holy Shock and Light of Dawn increased by 5%.

name: Morning Star
description: Every 5.0 sec, your next Dawnlight's damage or healing is increased by 5%, stacking up to 10 times.\n\nMorning Star stacks twice as fast while out of combat.

name: Obduracy
description: Speed increased by 2% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 2%.

name: Punishment
description: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Rebuke casts an extra Crusader Strike.

name: Quickened Invocation
description: Divine Toll's, Holy Armament's, and Holy Prism's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

name: Radiant Glory
description:
Avenging Wrath is replaced with Radiant Glory.

Radiant Glory
Wake of Ashes activates Avenging Wrath for 8 sec.

name: Recompense
description: After your Blessing of Sacrifice ends, 50% of the total damage it diverted is added to your next Judgment as bonus damage, or your next Word of Glory as bonus healing.\n\nThis effect's bonus damage cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health and its bonus healing cannot exceed 100% of your maximum health.

name: Righteous Cause
description: Each Holy Power spent has a 6% chance to reset the cooldown of Blade of Justice.

name: Righteous Protection
description: Blessing of Sacrifice now removes and prevents all Poison and Disease effects.

name: Rush of Light
description: The critical strikes of your Holy Power generating abilities grant you 5% Haste for 10 sec.

name: Sacred Strength
description: Holy Power spending abilities have 2% increased damage and healing.

name: Sacrifice of the Just
description: Reduces the cooldown of Blessing of Sacrifice by 60 sec.

name: Sacrosanct Crusade
description: Wake of Ashes surrounds you with a Holy barrier for 10% of your maximum health.\n\nHammer of Light heals you for 5% of your maximum health, increased by 1% for each additional target hit. Any overhealing done with this effect gets converted into a Holy barrier instead.

name: Sanctification
description: Casting Judgment increases the damage of Empyrean Hammer by 5% for 10 sec.\n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Sanctified Plates
description: Armor increased by 10%, Stamina increased by 5% and damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%.

name: Sanctify
description: Enemies hit by Divine Storm take 20% more damage from Consecration and Divine Hammers for 12 sec.

name: Seal of Might
description: Mastery increased by 2% and Intellect increased by 2%.

name: Seal of the Templar
description: Templar's Verdict damage increased by 25%.

name: Second Sunrise
description: Light of Dawn and Holy Shock have a 15% chance to cast again at 30% effectiveness.

name: Seething Flames
description: Wake of Ashes deals significantly reduced damage to secondary targets, but now causes you to lash out 2 extra times for 79 Radiant damage.

name: Selfless Healer
description: Flash of Light and Holy Light are 30% more effective on your allies and 40% of the healing done also heals you.

name: Shake the Heavens
description: After casting Hammer of Light, you call down an Empyrean Hammer on a nearby target every 2 sec, for 8 sec.

name: Solar Grace
description: Haste is increased by 5%.

name: Stand Against Evil
description: Turn Evil now affects 5 additional enemies.

name: Steed of Liberty
description:
Divine Steed also grants Blessing of Freedom for 3.0 sec.

 Blessing of Freedom:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 8 sec.

name: Stoicism
description: The duration of stun effects on you is reduced by 20%.

name: Sun Sear
description: Holy Shock and Light of Dawn critical strikes cause the target to be healed for an additional 281 over 4 sec.

name: Sun's Avatar
description: You link to your Dawnlights within 30 yds, causing 82 Radiant damage to enemies or 141 healing to allies that pass through the beams, reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Swift Justice
description: Reduces the cooldown of Judgment by 2 sec and Crusader Strike by 2 sec.

name: Tempest of the Lightbringer
description: Divine Storm projects an additional wave of light, striking all enemies up to 20 yds in front of you for 20% of Divine Storm's damage.

name: Templar Strikes
description: Crusader Strike loses a charge but is now a combo ability.\n\nTemplar Strike slashes an enemy for 64 Radiant damage and gets followed up by Templar Slash that deals 74 Radiant damage. Templar Slash always critically strikes.

name: Unbound Freedom
description: Blessing of Freedom increases movement speed by 30%, and you gain Blessing of Freedom when cast on a friendly target.

name: Unbreakable Spirit
description: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Lay on Hands by 30%.

name: Undisputed Ruling
description: Hammer of Light applies Judgment to its targets, and increases your Haste by 12% for 6 sec.

name: Unrelenting Charger
description: Divine Steed lasts 2 sec longer and increases your movement speed by an additional 30% for the first 3 sec.

name: Vengeful Wrath
description: Hammer of Wrath deals up to 50% additional damage based on its target's health. Lower health targets receive more damage.

name: Walk Into Light
description: Infusion of Light occurs 100% more often during Avenging Wrath.

name: Will of the Dawn
description: Movement speed increased by 5% while above 80% health.\n\nWhen your health is brought below 35%, your movement speed is increased by 40% for 5 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 1 min.

name: Worthy Sacrifice
description: You automatically cast Blessing of Sacrifice onto an ally within 40 yds when they are below 35% health and you are not in a loss of control effect.\n\nThis effect activates 100% of Blessing of Sacrifice's cooldown.

name: Wrathful Descent
description: When Empyrean Hammer critically strikes, 50% of its damage is dealt to nearby enemies.\n\nEnemies hit by this effect deal 5% reduced damage to you for 8 sec.

name: Wrench Evil
description: Turn Evil's cast time is reduced by 100%.

name: Zealot's Fervor
description: Auto-attack speed increased by 20%.

name: Zealous Vindication
description: Hammer of Light instantly calls down 2 Empyrean Hammers on your target when it is cast.

name: Paladin Retribution 12.1 Class Set 2pc
description: Divine Purpose has an additional 10% chance to activate, and consuming it grants Divine Power, increasing Holy damage done by 10% for 12 sec.

name: Paladin Retribution 12.1 Class Set 4pc
description: Consuming Divine Purpose grants Divine Arbiter, empowering your other Holy Power spenders to unleash an arbiter of light at their primary target, dealing 139 Holy damage and 96 Holy damage to enemies within 8 yds. Cannot occur while Divine Arbiter is active.
